title: Prove a scoped paid-profile invariant for adjacent swaps with movable native maps (no new κ)
body:
The proposed move swaps adjacent commuting ADDs and lets their incident late native maps change, while retaining every other contact, every shared prelude line contract and the complete 632-field interface. The exact census finds 98 eligible pairs and 1,077 frame assignments. All 74 feasible assignments preserve the source paid histogram exactly; 24 swaps are infeasible. This rejects this two-contact step for every rank price. No higher κ or global commuting-window optimum is claimed.

The finite domains are complete: every quotient interval has dimension at most five. The graph recount matches the actual source paid climbs and includes all eight rank-eight center jobs. It preserves all 408 independent dirty helper inputs. This differs from Matarener's reported windows through K=8 with warp maps fixed; it does not repeat or independently certify that search. Propagating changes to a third contact, changed prelude directions, phase frames, center recipes or a different controller remains outside scope.

Validation: both isolated normal and optimized registered replays pass, using integer containment, dimensions and histogram equality. Controls cover scalar noncommutation, conflicting shared map contracts, ordinary noncontainment and complete RREF subspace counts. Metadata/source pins pass. No candidate survived, so no operator/phase, compiler/outer or selected-frontier replay was needed. Reproduce with `python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/commuting-warp-retiming`.

Scientific inputs remain pinned to main b91956876e5b4122fd89179f1b57557ff8378f15; publication branch starts at refreshed main bee95ce88f9f19802f0613f92838895cd0e14a1f. The selected record and both live source inputs are unchanged. Final overlap refresh covered 303 open PRs and the discussion/local corpus reported by the helper; no same changed-graph/map result was found. Scope and source attribution are in PROOF.md, TASK.json and SOURCES.json.

Credit Cinna Davis, Cao Yifan, Matarener, Dugongue, zxv, Jacob Alan Sussman and the retained native/scalar/Clifford/compiler lineage. Prepared for 1337isnot1337 with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0; author-checked evidence, no independent human review or proof-kernel verification.
